question: How do broad recipient-bin representation and within-bin RNA differences contribute to finite-pool main-alias contrasts?
decision: Refine population and measurement choice for the later-output question; retain mixture and within-bin components without asserting a purified-state response or survival effect.
strongest_rival: Unresolved within-bin mixture, pooled biological units, sampling and indirect dose association can explain the observed RNA pattern.
discriminator: Exact symmetric decomposition of each of four prespecified marker means/detection across three original lineage-associated bins; separate oligodendrocyte description. Components can coexist or oppose and do not establish causal mediation.
exposure_record: Fully EXPOSED. Prior immune RNA and animal results, paper/S6/S3, all recovered-bin counts and A36 source_representation_v1 results were inspected. Source Table S3 already reports residual engineered-IL10 IFN enrichment. New freeze preserves exposure.
biological_unit: Source table row and one observed condition library/pool; individual mouse-to-cell mapping unavailable.
nesting_and_overlap: Cells nested in condition pools; old-control shared across contrasts. Reused source tables and metadata-review products are the same evidence lineage.
population_and_selection: Unchanged original Astrocytes_qNSCs, aNSCs_NPCs, Neuroblasts and Oligodendrocytes in Young, Control, WT5, Mut5. No thresholds, relabeling, reclustering, resampling or new QC exclusions. Exactly 16 declared genes.
contrast: Mut5-WT5, Mut5-Control, WT5-Control, Young-Control reference; no other-dose expression or age interaction.
endpoint: Per-gene stored log-normalized RNA mean and raw detection; broad-bin recovery; symmetric representation and within-bin arithmetic contributions to three-lineage-bin pooled marker differences.
methods: Hash-bound sparse R extraction from original RNA counts/data with complete cell and library-total denominators; independent Python log1p(10000*count/total) reconstruction and math.fsum summaries; symmetric decomposition checked against directly pooled sparse entries. Identity/context genes describe original labels only. No new IFN score or enrichment.
missingness_and_exclusions: Absent gene remains NA, zero counts remain in denominator, empty bin yields undefined decomposition rather than silently dropping it. WT50/Mut50 and WT1/Mut1 excluded from this new main-pair question. All unfavorable/mixed markers retained.
multiplicity: All 16 genes and four contrasts retained. Four IFN-associated genes each decomposed for mean and detection. No P values, confidence intervals or population inference.
precision_basis: Finite observed source/pool descriptions. Exact integer and rational checks verify arithmetic; no population uncertainty is identifiable.
interpretation_limit: No tissue census, purified NSC identity, population effect, independent replication, fate, secretion, IFN type, survival, maturation, age modification or injury repair.
stop_rule: Stop on hash, dimension, barcode, denominator, normalized-scale or arithmetic mismatch. R process limits: 12 GiB RSS, 15 GiB cgroup, 1800 s. Preserve failed run; any code/design correction needs new version. Verify sufficient live executor resources before launch.
amendment_reason: New exposed recipient stage following source qualification; no original Nn26 contract is amended.
